comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Vertically integrated homebuilder selling homes to consumers; lots are incidental, unlike Forestar's B2B lot development for builders.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling to consumers with mortgage and rental arms; Forestar's lot-supplier and its largest customer, but a different business.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Consumer-facing homebuilder with mortgage and title services; buys finished lots rather than selling them to builders.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Mainly a homebuilder, though it develops lots and sells some to other builders; lot sales are secondary.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling homes and mortgages to consumers; does not operate as a B2B lot developer.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Asset-light homebuilder using controlled lots, with mortgage and title services to consumers; different from lot development.
